findings.title: Shared masker context fallback
findings.detail: MaskUnexpectedErrors() is passed as an instance, so Strawberry 0.323.2 reuses it and overwrites self.execution_context per request; under concurrency the anonymise_error fallback can read another request's query. The primary error.source.body check covers every value-bearing error on this path, so no leak path was found. Concurrent interleaving is untested.
findings.fix: Pass MaskUnexpectedErrors as a class/factory so each request gets its own context; also clears Strawberry's shared-instance deprecation.

findings.title: Traceback dropped for unexpected faults on this root
findings.detail: For registerNetworkInterest requests, unexpected non-psycopg resolver faults log only ref, field and class name, with no message or stack. Debuggability only.
findings.fix: Optionally log a stack without exception message or frame locals, or rely on ref plus local reproduction.

findings.title: Control-character refusals labelled as ID numbers
findings.detail: serverError maps any server 'invalid' on name/district/mandal/note that passes check() to COPY.errors.idNumber. The server's _free_text_ok also refuses C0 control characters (e.g. a pasted tab), which the client does not check, so those refusals show the Aadhaar sentence.
findings.fix: Mirror the control-character test in check(), or apply the ID-number mapping only to text containing a non-ASCII digit run.

findings.title: Stale 'wording unchanged' comment
findings.detail: The NETWORK doc comment still says the former ROADMAP items keep 'their wording unchanged', but the lawyer card title changed in this commit.
